config.editProviderNameHint: Renaming updates every model that references it

config.contextDefaultHint: Empty means the official default (200K for custom models)
config.apiKeyPlaceholder: Written in plaintext to config.toml api_key
config.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved; clear and save to delete, edit to overwrite
config.envKeyHint: Read the key from env vars, comma separated; takes precedence over the session login
config.namePlaceholder: Label shown in the model picker
